description: This file provides utility functions to automate the process of generating lexer and parser code using flex and bison tools, including platform-specific path handling, SHA1 checksum retrieval, and patching flex output for 64-bit compatibility.

methods.name: get_tool_path_platform
methods.description: Constructs the path to a tool based on platform-specific directory structure.

methods.name: get_tool_path
methods.description: Returns the full path to a tool, appending extension on Windows.

methods.name: get_tool_file_sha1s
methods.description: Returns list of SHA1 checksum file paths for relevant tools and DLLs.

methods.name: run_flex
methods.description: Executes flex to generate lexer code, patches output for 64-bit compatibility.

methods.name: run_bison
methods.description: Executes bison to generate parser code, optionally generates header.

methods.name: get_input_files
methods.description: Returns list of input source files for parser generation.

methods.name: get_output_files
methods.description: Returns list of output files generated by parser tools.

methods.name: generate_parser
methods.description: Main function to run flex and bison, or output input/output file lists based on command-line args.
